slides.title: Displaced children in Tigray are going hungry
slides.body: A humanitarian assessment seen by Addis Standard

slides.title: of ~11,800 displaced children screened had moderate acute malnutrition
slides.body: Screening in September and October in Laelay Adiabo, Axum and Adwa, Tigray.

slides.title: hectares showed crop growth in Raya Azebo
slides.body: Out of more than 15,000 cultivated. About 10,000 hectares went unplanted after May rains failed.

slides.title: Cholera in Wag Hamra, Amhara
slides.body: Humanitarian sources report limited treatment supplies, including fluids, the assessment says.

slides.title: people may still be displaced in Afar
slides.body: Figures are hard to verify. Some displaced from Abaala and Megale have returned home.

slides.title: Health care under strain
slides.body: Sheraro hospitals face insecurity, supply shortages and unpaid salaries. Facilities in Wukro and Adwa were reportedly looted.

slides.title: Let aid reach every family safely.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
